new_theorem.statement: For a literal physical crossing M and physical row pair a,b with pair-anchored third-volume W_ab>0, the full ambient quadratic-plus-affine form has a continuous C0 density and ||p_Q||inf <= 3*2^(5/6) W_ab^(-1/6).
new_theorem.canonical_corollary: If two canonical E3 row marginals are each at least 3/4, then W_ab>=E3(M)/2 and ||p_Q||inf <= 6 E3(M)^(-1/6).
new_theorem.scope_note: This is a sharper pair-concentrated specialization. The previously completed account03/B02 marginal-free aggregate-E3 theorem already pays every positive E3 crossing with a larger universal coefficient.

structural_lemma.statement: Writing W_ab=D2 E1(C), H_ab=D2 E2(C), if 4 D2 H_ab < W_ab^2 then the squared residual singular tail after the largest residual direction is at most [W_ab-sqrt(W_ab^2-4D2H_ab)]/(2D2) <= 2H_ab/W_ab; H_ab=0<W_ab forces crossing rank three.
structural_lemma.scope_note: Coefficient geometry only; no rough-input perturbative deletion is claimed.
